task_completion.description: Agent opens CoppeliaSim and prepares a script or environment to connect via ZMQ Remote API on port 23000.
task_completion.visual_evidence: CoppeliaSim GUI is visible; terminal or IDE shows code referencing port 23000 and the ZMQ Remote API.

task_completion.description: Agent executes a script that drives the robot arm through multiple homing-and-return cycles.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the robot arm in different joint configurations or moving between a home position and target poses in the CoppeliaSim scene.

task_completion.description: Agent captures Cartesian end-effector positions for at least 90 total trials (3 poses x 30 trials).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or a variable explorer shows a growing list of coordinates or trial counts reaching at least 90.

task_completion.description: Agent exports the trial data to the specific CSV path with the required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'ls' or 'cat') or file explorer shows /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/repeatability_data.csv exists with headers: pose_id, trial_id, target_x, target_y, target_z, measured_x, measured_y, measured_z, deviation_mm.

task_completion.description: Agent generates the summary report JSON with all required ISO-inspired metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/repeatability_report.json is displayed, containing fields: total_poses (>=3), trials_per_pose (>=30), worst_rp_mm, best_rp_mm, mean_rp_mm, overall_rp_mm, and iso_compliant: true.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran the simulation rather than just creating static files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the CoppeliaSim simulation clock running or the robot arm in different physical states, not just a text editor creating files.

integrity.description: Check that the RP values in the JSON are derived from the CSV data, not just placeholder numbers.
integrity.visual_evidence: The CSV file should contain varying 'measured' coordinates and 'deviation_mm' values that correspond to the summary statistics in the JSON.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent used the specified ZMQ port 23000.
integrity.visual_evidence: Code snippets in the trajectory must explicitly show the initialization of the ZMQ client on port 23000.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires exactly 3 distinct poses and 30 trials per pose (90 total rows in CSV). Poses must be separated by at least 0.05m. The output files must be located at /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/repeatability_data.csv and /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/repeatability_report.json. The 'iso_compliant' field in the JSON must be 'true' only if these minimum counts are met.
